title: The residual book - realistic execution, best of 564 trials
note: FIRST CYCLE PRICED HONESTLY. Cycles 1-5 charged a flat 15 bps per side, which is blind to order size, name liquidity and market stress; the same book under that model reads identically at USD 100k and USD 50M, which cannot be true. Execution is now commission + liquidity-tiered half-spread + square-root impact against the name's own daily volume, multiplied on violent days, all priced on information strictly before the trade. Book size USD 100,000, which is inside the measured capacity ceiling of roughly USD 1M. Configuration is the best of 564 declared trials on research years, so the deflated Sharpe will refuse it and should: at that trial count nothing selected on research can clear, which is exactly why this sealed read is the instrument rather than the backtest.
sealed_note: 2026 was read deliberately and once. No parameter was swept to produce this configuration, so nothing in the forward number is contaminated by selection - which will stop being true the moment tuning starts.
